title: What Scripture Actually Says About Perfectionism (It's Not Excellence)
caption:
Perfectionism looks like high standards. Most of the time it's fear of looking bad.

Scripture says God remembers we are dust. He's not surprised by your limits. So finish the thing you've been polishing for months, show someone the rough draft, and get better on the next one. Faithful and finished beats perfect and hidden.

Save this for the project you keep not sending.

#faith #godlyman #humility #christianmen #work
